stories.title: Locals in the NFL: Safety Zayne Anderson has career day for Miami
stories.summary: The former Stansbury and BYU great recorded the first sack of his six-year NFL career and intercepted MVP-candidate Josh Allen.

stories.title: Will Hardy sends message in Utah Jazz's home loss to Mavericks
stories.summary: The Utah Jazz lost an eighth straight game in front of the Delta Center crowd on Sunday night.

stories.title: Bill Clinton tells governors he hopes new political landscape can 'take some of the poison out'
stories.summary: As dozens of newly elected governors gathered in Park City, Utah, former President Bill Clinton encouraged them to make a to-do list of priorities, and to work together to solve some of the biggest problems in the country.

stories.title: Utah man wins 1st place for United States in The Great Wall of China Marathon
stories.summary: Across the world, a Utah man completed a once-in-a-lifetime experience running a marathon on one of the Seven Wonders of the World.

stories.title: Do school phone bans help students learn? So far, gains are 'modest'
stories.summary: The argument for school cellphone bans is simple: Phones offer endless distraction. Take them away and students can focus on classwork, engage with peers and, ultimately, learn more.

stories.title: Murray mother of 6 seriously injured in hit-and-run
stories.summary: A 37-year-old Murray mother of six was seriously injured in a hit-and-run on Saturday. Her family is asking for help to find the driver who hit her and left the scene.

stories.title: Delta Air Lines says issue that delayed flights nationwide has been resolved
stories.summary: Delta Air Lines has resolved an issue with its weight and balance system that caused nationwide delays leading into a busy Thanksgiving travel week, the airline said

stories.title: Lawyer: Father and daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were traveling to family baptism
stories.summary: A father and daughter were traveling to a family baptism ceremony in California when they were detained by masked immigration officers while boarding a flight in Seattle. That's according to their lawyer on Sunday.

stories.title: Park City's Light the World Giving Machine helps those locally and internationally
stories.summary: The Light the World Giving Machine officially opened to the public in Park City on Saturday.

stories.title: What are digital license plates? Utah to consider a bill that would allow them
stories.summary: Utah has dabbled in digital driver's licenses in recent years, along with other digital equipment, but license plates could be the next on the digital frontier.

stories.title: Salt Lake City International Airport receives top honors from TIME Magazine
stories.summary: Salt Lake City International Airport has earned top honors on the world stage after TIME Magazine named it the World's Best Large Airport for 2027.

stories.title: Ground beef by air: Delivery drones coming to a Walmart near you
stories.summary: Salt Lake City shoppers who forget the ground beef may soon get it dropped from the sky.
